steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Spatial planning considers how people move through and use spaces — function, flow and atmosphere are key. | Key Fact: Scale drawing uses set ratios (1:50, 1:100) to represent spaces accurately; orthographic projection shows plan, elevation and section. | Key Fact: Architectural models communicate 3D ideas that drawings cannot — they reveal spatial relationships, light and material qualities. | Key Fact: Responding to site means understanding the context: existing structures, landscape, climate, culture and community.
